comment: mkmap.c join_map() with rooms it cannot pick a square in: #wizloadlua fakewiz1 leaves its irregular room in svr.rooms[], and #wizloadlua minefill then runs mkmap() on the same level. init_map() clears every square's roomno, so join_map()'s somexy() finds no square of the old irregular room, and C prints impossible("No start/end room loc in join_map.") six times, each before digging between the two rooms' centres, while the level program goes on.
